title: Overnight Bacterial Culture
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.79bhr2n

steps.title: Prepare LB Broth
steps.instruction: Pour the appropriate volume of LB broth into a selected autoclaved container.

steps.title: Inoculate Media
steps.instruction: Add bacteria to the LB broth using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Add a frozen aliquot of bacteria directly to the LB broth.
Alternatively, use an inoculation loop to select an isolated colony from a media plate and shake the loop in the media until the fragment is loose and floating.

steps.title: Seal Container
steps.instruction: Loosely seal the container to allow for gas exchange.

substeps.instruction: Use tape to secure the loosely fitted lid of a tube, or
Use tinfoil to cover a flask.

steps.title: Incubate Culture
steps.instruction: Grow the liquid culture overnight in an orbital shaker.

substeps.instruction: Set the shaker to the optimal growing temperature for the bacterial species (typically 30 or 37° C).
